title: PBMC, pre-tumor resection, patient 2, gene expression library
characteristics_ch1: cell type: circulating peripheral mononuclear immune cells
treatment_protocol_ch1: N/A, cells were obtained directly from human whole blood, and directly used for scRNA and CITE-seq experiments, upon thawing.
growth_protocol_ch1: N/A, cells were obtained directly from human whole blood.
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were isolated from whole blood via density gradient separation, frozen viably, and stored in liquid nitrogen. For sequencing experiments, cells were thawed, counted, stained with CITE-seq antibodies, and loaded directly into 10x Genomics 5' chip K for polyA tagging, using the manufacturer's recommendation.
10x Genomics 5' V2
description: also sequenced on Illumina NovaSeq X Plus
processed data matrix also includes data for ADT
data_processing: fastq files from GEX, VDJ and CSP were processed together using cellranger multi. CSP was processed using uploaded feature_README.txt file for CSP barocodes. GEX and VDJ were processed using reference downloaded from 10X's website (v. 2020A)
Assembly: GRCh38, builds downloaded from 10X's website specfic to GEX and VDJ data (v. 2020A)
Supplementary files format and content: feature, barcode and counts matrices from cellranger multi, run on combined dataset from GEX, CSP and VDJ data for each sample
